coder_notes: Phase NA multi-cancer proton reirradiation study; the only intervention is radiotherapy, so no agents and S6 fails. Glioblastoma is named only in the description text of the registered arm 'Cohort 1: Central Nervous System' (Group 2 CNS Reirradiation Registry), not in the arm label itself, conditions, title or inclusion criteria; if arm descriptions do not count under D27B the population would be not_glioblastoma (CNS cancer unspecified). Exclusion at S6 is unaffected. IDH-wildtype, IDH1-mutant and 1p19q are mentioned only as histology definitions of eligible CNS tumour types, not as entry requirements; no biomarker rows. Cohort 8 is a NO_INTERVENTION registry, not a control.
